item.title: Dam Short Film Festival celebrates 22nd year
item.description: Movie lovers can enjoy Nevada’s largest film festival as the 22nd Annual Dam Short Film Festival returns to screen more than 150 short films over a six-day period, Feb. 11-16 in the Elaine K. Smith Building.

item.title: Investigation into officer-involved shooting continues
item.description: Incident took place a year ago

item.title: Community effort
item.description: Despite cold temperatures and light rains, dozens of volunteers, including youth from the Nevada Civil Air Patrol and JROTC, helped remove thousands of wreaths that had been placed last month at the Southern Nevada Veterans Cemetery.

item.title: Downtown vitality is everyone’s business
item.description: Boulder City has always been a place that knows who it is.

item.title: Eagles split a pair of games this week
item.description: Splitting a pair of league games this past week, Boulder City High School boys basketball sits in third place in the 3A league standings.

item.title: Celebrating America’s 250th anniversary with love
item.description: Every family likely celebrates love in a different manner during the holiday season, don’t they? Isn’t it likely that in this 250th year of our nation’s independence from Great Britain, America would celebrate love in a unique manner?

item.title: Lady Eagles move up in standings
item.description: Winning a pair of league games this past week, Boulder City High School girls basketball jumped up to third place in the 3A league standings.

item.title: Flag football evens record with wins
item.description: Winning a pair of games this past week, Boulder City High School flag football advanced to 6-6 on the season.

item.title: Former BCHS football coach arrested
item.description: Former Boulder City High School head football coach Frank “Bubba” Mariani was arrested by Boulder City police on an array of felony counts alleging lewd behavior.
